capture.final_message:
Use the existential descriptions of pointwise set actions.

- For the first conjunct, prove set equality by extensionality. Since \(s\) is nonempty and \(0\smul x=0\), the set \(0\smul s\) is exactly the singleton \(\{0\}\), which is the zero element of `Set β`. Nonemptiness is essential: \(0\smul\varnothing=\varnothing\).

- For the equivalence, both universally quantified statements can be proved independently:
  - `a • t` is precisely the image of \(x\mapsto a\smul x\) on \(t\), by the definition/membership characterization of pointwise scalar multiplication.
  - If `s • t` is nonempty, unpacking one of its elements gives witnesses \(a\in s\) and \(b\in t\), hence `t.Nonempty`.

Thus organize the proof around set extensionality and simplification/unpacking of membership in `a • t` and `s • t`; each implication of the `Iff` may ignore its hypothesis and establish the target directly.
